method.name: controlled-local-perturbations
method.description: Replay selected O-010 cases five times under deterministic input-order, missingness, parent-gap, and redaction perturbations; compare result digests and classification IDs to the unperturbed case.

perturbations.description: Reverse static edges, runtime spans, and bindings before each replay; canonical output must remain stable.
Drop the database child span and binding while retaining its parent; the declared edge becomes modeled-not-observed.
Drop the HTTP parent span and binding while retaining its child; the result records an explicit missing-parent gap.
Apply local name and service-name redaction before replay; classifications and result digest must remain unchanged and the synthetic marker must not survive.

nonGuarantees: Five repetitions over eight repository-authored traces do not estimate production workload variance or exporter behavior.
The study evaluates explicit bindings only and does not measure automatic service-to-node binding quality.
A stable digest under these perturbations does not prove semantic correctness, completeness, or absence of unobserved behavior.
Redaction invariants cover the enumerated normalized free-text fields and do not authorize retaining payloads, headers, arbitrary attributes, or live user traces.

provenance.reference: O-010 local runtime reconciliation corpus; no external source
provenance.transformation: Study metadata selects bounded, deterministic in-memory perturbations over the versioned O-010 corpus; no source bodies, exporter payloads, or live traces are copied.
